title: Kubernetes Fundamentals
description: Understand container orchestration with Kubernetes: pods, deployments, services, and using kubectl to interact with clusters.
longDescription: This module introduces Kubernetes, the industry standard for container orchestration. You'll learn the core concepts (pods, deployments, services), how to use kubectl to inspect and manage resources, and how Kubernetes keeps applications running at scale.
whatYouLearn: Understand the Kubernetes architecture and key concepts
Deploy applications using Deployments and Pods
Expose applications with Services and use kubectl effectively
